details.publicNotes:
Appearance

A huge serpentine undead built from thousands of fused skulls and spines, its body coiling like a bone dragon, a storm of bone shards swirling around it. Its head is a cluster of interlocking skulls with a glow deep in the eye sockets. Four white skulls set in its brow still wear spectacles and a scholar's cap.
